messages:
zoe: Quick experiment idea: a guided walkthrough overlay on the pricing page that walks users through "what you pay for" in 3 steps and ends with a micro-calculator. Unique twist: a "benchmark slider" that swaps workload profiles (chat / summarization / embeddings) so visitors see token ranges per profile. Goal: clearer mental model -> fewer support pings and +0.5pp trial conversion. Launch proposal: Tue 09:00 PT behind flag `pricing_walkthrough_v1`.

carl: Love the slider. Two arms: A = overlay + slider (full guidance), B = slider + inline snapshot (no overlay). Hypothesis: overlay reduces bounce; inline snapshot converts faster. We'll A/B test.

mina: Copy plan: 3-step micro-scripts for overlay (15-20 words each), short benchmark blurbs per profile, and CTA microcopy for the calculator. Also include one-line privacy note for EU locales. I'll share drafts by Mon EOB.

ben: Dev notes: overlay should be lazy-loaded and behind feature flag. Calculator will call `/api/estimate-v1`. Events: `pricing:walkthrough_start`, `pricing:slider_change`, `pricing:calculator_submit`. Lead capture only if user completes walkthrough and clicks "Talk to sales" (to lower noise). Routing rule: if estimated_arr >= 40k OR user selects "compliance needs" -> sales-inbound, else -> nurture-sdr. Payload include `variant_id`, `workload_profile`, `seats`, `est_arr`, `user_country`, `consent_state`. ETA: 3 dev days for overlay + slider if copy/design final.

zoe: Analytics: instrument experiment_key `pricing_walkthrough_v1`, track funnel `pageview -> walkthrough_start -> slider_interact -> calc_submit -> trial_start`. Baseline conv = 3.4%; target +0.5pp. Also track support tickets with subject contains "pricing".

carl: UX detail: overlay step 2 will show benchmark numbers with a tiny graph (no heavy assets). Slider presets: "Prototype (5 devs)", "Growth (15 devs)", "Scale (50 devs)" but users can set custom seats. Default to Prototype.

mina: For copy: step 1 = "How we price: usage + seats"; step 2 = "Typical ranges for common workloads" with link to appendix; step 3 = "Ways to save (annual, batching, caching)". CTA = "Estimate your cost" and secondary "Talk to sales".

ben: Routing nuance: only create lead if user submits calculator AND (completes walkthrough OR checks "I want help"). That should reduce low-quality leads. Use `lead_source=pricing_walkthrough`.

launchbot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/pricing-walkthrough-4123456789 (flag: pricing_walkthrough_v1). A/B toggles enabled.

zoe: Launch plan: soft-launch Tue 09:00 PT at 20% traffic for 14 days, daily AM snapshot to #marketing-daily. If overlay increases estimator starts >15% and conversions don't follow, we'll iterate copy.

carl: One legal ask: ensure GDPR consent doesn't block overlay for EU; defer overlay display until consent or user interaction. Mina please add the short privacy note.

mina: Will do. Also adding micro-copy for accessibility (step labels). Draft in 3 hours.

ben: I'll wire events to Segment & Amplitude and include `variant_id`. Also adding feature-flag rollout plan.

zoe: Great work. Quick checklist: copy, design, dev, analytics hooks, legal signoff. Launch Tue 09:00 PT. Thanks team :rocket:
